meta_description: SRH Plastering Service Manchester delivers expert plastering, skimming, and rendering. Fast, reliable quotes. Call 07462 489861 today.
hero_subhead: From interior skimming to external rendering, we transform walls and ceilings with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Plastering Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: We handle everything from domestic interior finishing to commercial rendering and specialist repairs.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, professional finishing for walls and ceilings. We specialise in difficult repairs and coving work, leaving surfaces ready for decoration.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external finishes using quality materials. Protects your property and improves kerb appeal for years to come.

services.title: Damp Repairs & Remedial Plastering
services.desc: Specialised plastering solutions for properties affected by damp. We work with treatment specialists to ensure lasting results.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of old Artex ceilings with professional replacement skimming. Transforms dated interiors into clean, modern finishes.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Plastering
services.desc: Large-scale projects including offices, retail units, and warehouses. We work to schedule and manage multiple teams efficiently.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation & Taping
services.desc: Fitted plasterboard with taped and jointed finishes for new builds and extensions. Precise installation saves you time and money.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Manchester homeowners honest pricing and real craftsmanship.
about_para_1: SRH Plastering Service was founded on the principle that skilled plastering should be accessible and reliable. Over 12 years, we've built our reputation by turning up on time, finishing to a high standard, and treating every job—whether a small repair or a large commercial project—with the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because they know we won't cut corners or overcharge. We're a tight-knit team of experienced plasterers who take pride in the finish, and we're happy to discuss your project in detail before we start. References from local builders and homeowners are available on request.
reviews_heading: What Greater Manchester Homeowners Say About SRH Plastering

reviews.text: Had a massive water leak that ruined our bedroom ceiling. SRH came out within 48 hours, assessed the damage, and replastered the whole room beautifully. Professional, friendly, and fair price. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: We needed our 1960s kitchen skimmed before decorating. The team worked around our schedule and left everything spotless. The finish is perfect. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: Used SRH for external rendering on a renovation project. They matched the existing finish perfectly and completed on time. Clear communication throughout and a quality job.
reviews.author: Robert M.
